meta.name: face-swap
meta.description: Swap a face / character into video or images on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across community Wan 2-2 Animate (audio-driven character animation + identity swap), GPT Image 2 Edit (single-shot precise face swap on still images via reference composition), Nano Banana Edit (batch identity-preserving swap), Flux Kontext (single-ref high-fidelity local face edit), and Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro (transfer motion from one performance onto a target character). Picks the right model for the user's actual intent — single still vs video, full character vs face only, dialog scene vs silent motion. Triggers on "face swap", "swap face", "deepfake", "face replacement", "character swap", "head swap", "put X's face on Y", "make this video star X", "replace the actor in this video", "swap the character in the photo", "deepfake video", "ReActor alternative", or any explicit ask to substitute one identity for another.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将视频或图片中的人脸替换为指定角色
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把视频或照片中的人脸换成另一个人
copy.tagline_en: Swap a face or character into videos or images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to replace a face in a video or photo with another person

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的指令，用 RunComfy 工具把一张脸或角色换到图片或视频里。它会自动选最合适的模型来处理——比如单张图片、多张批量、视频加音频等。
howto.when: 当你明确要求换脸、换角色、深度伪造，或说“把X的脸放到Y上”“让这个视频的主角变成X”等类似话时触发。

say.text: 把这张照片里的脸换成我上传的这张。
把这个视频里的演员换成我给的这张脸。
把这一批照片里所有人的脸都换成同一个人的。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can swap a face or character into images or videos using the RunComfy tool. It automatically selects the best model for the task—single image, batch, video with audio, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for face swap, character swap, deepfake, or say things like 'put X's face on Y' or 'make this video star X'.

say_en.text: Swap the face in this photo with the one I uploaded.
Replace the actor in this video with the face I provided.
Swap the faces in all these photos to the same person.
